persona: a family on a tight budget
goal: Make an Excel monthly family budget with two sheets: Income (job 1, job 2, side gig, with amounts) and Expenses (rent, groceries, car, insurance, phone, utilities, fun, savings, each with Budget and Actual columns and a Difference column using a formula). Add total rows with SUM formulas on both sheets. Save it as {dir}\family-budget.xlsx

persona: Ray, gym owner with a small member database
goal: Write a SQLite SQL script for a small gym: tables for members, membership plans and check-ins with sensible columns and foreign keys, 5 sample plans, 10 sample members and 20 check-ins, and a final query that lists each member with their number of check-ins this month. Save it as {dir}\gym.sql

Write a Python script that cleans a messy volunteers CSV: trims spaces, makes names Title Case, makes emails lowercase, removes exact duplicate rows, and writes volunteers_clean.csv next to it, printing how many rows were removed. Also create a messy sample volunteers.csv with 15 rows including 3 duplicates and odd spacing. The script reads volunteers.csv from its own folder and uses only the standard library. Save both in {dir} as clean_volunteers.py and volunteers.csv

Build a mortgage payment calculator as one self-contained HTML file with JavaScript: inputs for home price, down payment, interest rate and years; it shows the monthly principal and interest payment and a 12-row first-year amortization table. Use the standard formula. Save it as {dir}\mortgage-calculator.html

persona: Stu, sales manager using Google Sheets
goal: Write a Google Apps Script for Google Sheets that adds a menu called Sales Tools with one item, Highlight stale leads, that colors light red every row on the Leads sheet whose Last Contact date (column E) is more than 14 days ago. Save it as {dir}\stale-leads.gs

Write a Word document: a one-page friendly project start letter from a kitchen remodeling contractor to a homeowner, with a short welcome, a table of the first three weeks (week, what happens, what the homeowner needs to do), and a list of what to expect each day. Save it as {dir}\project-start-letter.docx

Write a 4-email win-back sequence for a hair salon to send clients who have not booked in 90 days: subject line, preview text and body for each, friendly and short, with a [Booking Link] placeholder and a small offer only in email 3. Save it as {dir}\salon-winback.md

persona: Omar, owns a small hardware store
goal: Write a small Node.js command line program inventory.js that reads inventory.json (a list of items with name, sku, qty and reorderAt), prints the items that need reordering sorted by how far below reorderAt they are, and exits with code 0. Also create a sample inventory.json with 12 items where 4 need reordering. Save both in {dir}

Write a Windows batch-safe PowerShell script that renames every .jpg in a folder to ClientName_YYYY-MM-DD_001.jpg style names using a -Client parameter and each photo's last write date, numbering in date order, and prints old and new names. Parameters: -Folder and -Client. Add a -WhatIf switch that only prints. Save it as {dir}\rename-photos.ps1
Make a CSV run-of-show for a wedding day from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM in 30 minute rows: time, what happens, who is responsible, location, notes. Save it as {dir}\wedding-run-of-show.csv
